Epoch reward storage, partitioning, and iteration for stake rewards.

# Purpose
`fd_epoch_rewards.c` implements the storage and access logic for epoch stake rewards. It defines the `fd_epoch_rewards_t` shared-memory object and provides the functions needed to calculate its alignment and footprint, create it in shared memory with [`fd_epoch_rewards_new`](<#fd_epoch_rewards_new>), attach to it with [`fd_epoch_rewards_join`](<#fd_epoch_rewards_join>), detach with [`fd_epoch_rewards_leave`](<#fd_epoch_rewards_leave>), and invalidate it with [`fd_epoch_rewards_delete`](<#fd_epoch_rewards_delete>). The file also uses template-based container code to build a pool for `fd_epoch_stake_reward_t` objects, a hash map keyed by `fd_pubkey_t`, and a set of partition lists used to group rewards for later processing.

The file also provides the main reward operations. [`fd_epoch_rewards_insert`](<#fd_epoch_rewards_insert>) adds a stake reward to the pool and map while updating total counters. [`fd_epoch_rewards_hash_into_partitions`](<#fd_epoch_rewards_hash_into_partitions>) assigns each stored reward to one of `FD_REWARDS_MAX_PARTITIONS` lists by hashing the parent block hash together with the stake public key using `fd_siphash13`. The iterator functions [`fd_epoch_rewards_iter_init`](<#fd_epoch_rewards_iter_init>), [`fd_epoch_rewards_iter_done`](<#fd_epoch_rewards_iter_done>), [`fd_epoch_rewards_iter_next`](<#fd_epoch_rewards_iter_next>), and [`fd_epoch_rewards_iter_ele`](<#fd_epoch_rewards_iter_ele>) expose sequential access to the rewards in a selected partition.
